a: Treat health with the same intention as a career
Treat health less important than a career
Treat health only after a career

questions.q: Why does Kaki recommend cooking two meals at home?
a: To avoid overeating and save money
questions.why: She cooks enough for two meals to pace and save.

questions.q: What did Kaki notice about US and Japanese drink sizes?
a: US drinks are larger than Japanese ones
Japanese drinks are larger than US ones

questions.why: She says impactful exercise fits into routine.

questions.why: She says rest is about being in a safe place and caring for surroundings.
